title: Wind Turbine Stop-Event Ledger Recovery From SCADA Windows
dataset: Kelmarsh wind farm data (Zenodo 5841834, v0.0.3) 2016-2021 and Penmanshiel wind farm data (Zenodo 8253010, v0.1.0) 2016-2019: official yearly SCADA + status-log archives
license: CC BY 4.0 (Zenodo API license id cc-by-4.0 on both records; owner Cubico Sustainable Investments Ltd release statement)
blocker: Public-source reversibility: adaptive full-corpus retrieval recovers 12.5% of public cases at rank-1; both farms and their controller status logs are public, so a recovered origin yields the hidden ledger verbatim.
notes: Slot 3 of batch-20260920-044727; immutable Shipd pair problem jx7d7hc2kwrxdxn9r0eg4pjq4h8eebx9 / dataset jd7bgzt14yjrdhr55hvybg8kjn8ef7y5 (not yet bound; browser unauthenticated this run).

Every other gate passed: CC BY 4.0 verified on both Zenodo records, 14 archives MD5-verified (3.46 GB), native controller-log targets, 1372 train / 574 test cases from 86 turbine-years, 36 held-out calendar blocks with a 1-day guard, class minimums enforced in prepare.py, novelty 6/10 with no platform or registry duplicate.
Package files (prepare.py, grade.py, forms, source verification, acquisition, novelty audit, premortem) are retained for reuse but MUST NOT be submitted: the readiness verdict is Hold, not Proceed.
Slot batch-20260920-044727-task-003 returned to scouting for a distinct replacement candidate; the Shipd pair was never bound and no website write occurred.
proposed_input: One turbine x ~24 h window of 40 transformed 10-minute channels (36 own physical sensors + 4 farm-context channels) as NPZ, plus start_hour.
proposed_output: JSON ledger of stop events (start/end step, one of 8 classes grouped from native service-contract categories) plus confidence.

unresolved_gates: lookup_attack: rank-1 origin recovery 3/24 (12.5%) on the final ordinal representation v6; workspace precedent for a pass is ~2.5-3%. Evidence: Working/batch-20260920-044727/batch-20260920-044727-task-003/LOOKUP_GATE_EVIDENCE.md

capability_matched_baseline and null_metric_audit: measured on the pilot split only (GBM 0.5497, rule+majority 0.2806, empty 0.0921, perfect 1.0); the full-split _analyze.py run was not completed on v6 because the lookup gate already fails.
A build task must not be created from this entry.

evidence.lookup_attack_method: Adaptive re-coding of the complete official raw corpus (92 turbine-year series, 4,323,440 steps) + FFT sliding-window NCC per channel (whole + chunked with +-8 shift) + 0.70-1.40 stretch grid + banded DTW rerank of the top 20; hit = rank-1 correct turbine-year within +-12 steps.
evidence.smoke_test: passed on v5/v6 prepare+grade (perfect exactly 1.0, sample 0.063, malformed row-local 0.985, 7 structural mutations raise InvalidSubmissionError, byte-identical deterministic reprepare)
